articles.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee
articles.snippet: Chinese-language platform Xinbi is accused of operating on crypto transactions as it offered services to other criminal networks.

articles.title: Tether pushes into private credit with $400 million fund with Fasanara
articles.snippet: The USDT issuer will help source lending opportunities and provide stablecoin payment infrastructure for Fasanara's private credit network.

articles.title: PayPal expands stablecoin rails with custom token issuance platform
articles.snippet: The PYUSDx stablecoin developer platform, backed by PayPal USD (PYUSD), is built with the help of M0 and MoonPay.

articles.title: Hunter Biden's new LAPTOP token lost 98% of its value in under an hour after $1.6 billion debut
articles.snippet: LAPTOP swung from $190 to under $4 within minutes of opening on Base. Onchain records show tokens had been distributed to market makers for a week before trading began.

articles.title: OpenAI says 10,000 AI agents solved a $1 million math problem. Now mathematicians are fighting
articles.snippet: An internal model more powerful than GPT-6 Astra produced a proposed solution to one of mathematics’ seven Millennium Prize Problems, though questions are emerging over how independently it got there.
